title: ref2video — Heroines in a Miniature Bar
blurb: Five action heroines composited into a Rolife miniature bar plate with Qwen-Image-Edit, animated through MiniMax H3, and cut into one continuous reel. The run report documents the locked quality recipe found across 20+ renders — bypass the Kontext scale node, feed refs at ~2MP, keep the plate at ~1MP — which took render time from ten minutes to two.

thumb.alt: An empty miniature bar set, then five action heroines composited into it one after another
